lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 18, Step 2, question 1, and p. 19, Step 4, question 2, "Was your qualifying relative a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. resident alien, or a resident of Canada or Mexico? ... No. STOP ... You can't claim this person as a dependent"; p501 p. 21, Multiple Support Agreement, "two or more persons, each of whom would be able to claim the person as a dependent but for the support test, together provide more than half of the person's support" (the support test of a qualifying relative; i1040gi p. 19, Step 4, "For whom you provided over half of the person's support in 2025. But see ... Multiple support agreements"). New: the reply drops the citizenship test from its dependency tests: 200 completed values, project no and candidate yes, every one on an entry that is neither a U.S. citizen, national or resident alien nor a resident of Canada or Mexico (192 qualifying relatives, for example classm.s2.3.deepseek dep_c, a 22-year-old child; 8 qualifying children, for example classm.f8889.1.deepseek dep_c). It also drops the "Could you be claimed as a dependent" test (sa.dependent; Step 2, question 4, and Step 4, question 5) and the joint-return spouse-relative route (dependent.spouse_relative), with no completed witness. As the earlier ruling, it refuses dependent.multiple_support for every entry (120 completed unknowns on qualifying children, for example classm.f4952.1.deepseek dep_c; generated 126 dep_b refused) and asks dependent.lawful of household_member entries (14, for example classm.clcw26.2.deepseek dep_b). Its new part-year residency route asks dependent.born_died where the months answer already applies the birth and death rule (1 completed, mutation.t2.qss_sdtw_sli dep_a). Its earlier joint_return question on qualifying relatives is gone. executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/dependent.deepseek.json`; 1,638 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 2,358 partial records; 7,537 comparisons): 6,234 of 7,537 agree; 483 candidate-unknown, 338 value, 316 project-refuses, 161 project-unknown, 5 candidate-refuses; on returns the full interview completes: 200 value, 155 candidate-unknown, 3 project-unknown, 1 candidate-refuses.
